children: Facebook and Instagram recovered after a brief service disruption affected thousands of users in the U.S. on Sunday, September 20, with disruptions also reported in several other countries on Monday, September 21.

The U.S. outage began around 8:55 p.m. ET on September 20. Downdetector recorded more than 17,000 reports for Facebook and over 5,000 for Instagram at the peak. Reports fell sharply by about 10 p.m. ET, indicating the services had largely recovered.
Users in Singapore, the Philippines, Australia, and Mexico also reported problems accessing Facebook and Instagram on September 21, according to

Meta did not immediately respond to Seeking Alpha's request for comment. Downdetector’s figures are based on user reports and do not represent the actual number of affected users. The outage follows similar disruptions seen in July this year.

title: Facebook, Instagram recover after brief outage hits users in U.S. and other markets
